<thought>The observed isotopic pattern shows a dominant M peak followed by progressively smaller M+1, M+2, etc., with intensities matching the expected binomial distribution for 13C in a molecule containing ~13 carbons. No characteristic Cl, Br, or S patterns are present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
